mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS increases over the past 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL shows an annualized increase above 3%, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past 6 months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST decreases by more than 10% over the past 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is flat or declining, it signals a supply-side constraint, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth is below 1% and INDPRO is flat or declining.
